scope: actual ray-cut realization of one compatible physical based F9 gauge; all 88 archived strict J witnesses; theorem for every actual root angle and every integer deck coordinate
not_claimed: numerical or Lean proof of physical straightening and ray landing
recovery of uniquely archived whiskers (none were specified)
closure of full issue62 or global MLC gates

gauge.root_reference_domain: D=W minus (K9 union root ray at 249/896)

remaining_six_cuts.region: outside the closed G carrier N

all_integer_root_criterion: n=0 and parent(i)=parent(j); on strict original J sides this means j is the same-parent mate of i

coarse_only_prefix_obstruction.all_Omega3_paths_to_physical_Ai: delta=p(i); follows from constancy of winding on connected K3
coarse_only_prefix_obstruction.consequence: no Omega3-only path from this x is root-compatible at any A2 or A3 endpoint
coarse_only_prefix_obstruction.proof: NOTE.md, Section 8, A concrete impossibility for the extra coarse-only prefix condition

orientation_note: For the explicit g=kappa_prime*kappa^{-1}, delta=w01-w02=parent(i)-parent(j). The historical C4 source comparison printed the opposite sign; its nonzero/root decisions agree.
